column1: # Trust windows: the last time each run's solution can be trusted -- one line per run, tab-separated.
# Movies cut there (rerender_frames.py --t-max): only frames at or before t_max set the colour scale and
# are stitched; later frames stay on disk, untouched.  Figures and any paper quote nothing after t_max.

column3: boundary return on the halved box (r = 32 out and back; local_speed frames speckle from t ~ 60); constraints stay ~3e-3 until t ~ 78 and the settled horizon R 2.4746 is unchanged to t = 100, but nothing after 64 is quoted
boundary return on the halved box, as static_hold_L64_ml3_t100 (same grid); its K speckle reaches the static hold's t = 64 level at t = 62 and L2_Ham leaves its 2.5e-3 floor (x2) at t = 72

the inflating throat leaves level 2 for level 1 (coordinate r = 8) at t ~ 57 and L2_Ham doubles off its 1.3e-3 floor at t = 59; the in-code R_eq/R_pol rays (finest level, r < 4) lose the throat at t ~ 41, so later throat radii come from the chi slice

died t = 42.36 (NaN); the far-side puncture sat at the min_chi floor 1e-8 from t ~ 4 and its shift ran away from ~t = 20 (ergo diagnostic), but the throat (R_eq to 1e-4) and the constraints stayed clean until t = 42.34 -- t <= 40 is quoted with the far side known to be clamped

boundary return on the halved box, as static_hold_L64_ml3_t100 (same grid; the sponge's extra Kreiss-Oliger dissipation removes only grid-scale noise, not the long-wavelength gauge pulse): K in the frame window's 12-16 ring leaves its floor at t ~ 60-63 and grows inward, overtaking the throat region by t ~ 87; L2_Mom leaves its 1.3e-4 floor at t ~ 62 (x2 at 70), L2_Ham x2 at 84.5; the far-side puncture reaches the min_chi floor at t ~ 95.  The throat shrinks steadily throughout (MOTS R -0.61 % at 64, -2.9 % at 100), but nothing after 64 is quoted

the L64 boundary return, as its siblings (same grid); the collapse itself is clean before it (R_eq -13.6 % at t = 64, constraints growing only with the collapse, as in the static hold) and the run dies at t = 70.64 inside the collapsing throat (NaN in K, level 3)

L2_Ham x2 off its 5.4e-4 plateau at t = 78.8 and L2_Mom x2 (off 3.8e-5) at t = 66.8 -- the slow level-2 interface mode (dt-ladder attribution), not the throat; far-side chi_min on the 1e-8 floor from t = 91.9; no boundary return before t = 100 on the full box (return ~ 120).  MOTS shrinks steadily and smoothly throughout (-1 % at t = 71, -3.14 % at t = 100) and max|K| stays flat ~6e-3, but nothing after 78 is quoted

boundary return on the halved box at t ~ 62-64, as every L64 hold (same grid as static_hold_L64_ml3_t100); L2_Mom x2 (off 1.4e-4) at t = 70.3, L2_Ham NEVER doubles off its 3.4e-3 plateau to t = 100.  The min_chi 1e-4 floor is pinned only t = 0-3.17, then chi_min lifts off and rises to 1.0e-3 by t = 100 (the parent run sat at 1e-8 from t ~ 4 and died 42.36); the MOTS finder loses its surface after t ~ 15, so throat numbers are the ray radii.  Throat frozen: R_eq -0.016 % over the full run.  Nothing after 64 is quoted

L2_Ham x2 off its 7.3e-4 plateau at t = 67.1, L2_Mom x2 (off 2.4e-5) at t = 48.0 -- the growth tracks the collapsing throat itself (a horizon forms: MOTS detaches at t ~ 64), not the boundary (return ~ 120, never reached).  The tau measurement window (deltaR 1-30 %, t = 46.9-61.8) and the detachment sit inside t <= 67; chi_min falls to ~1e-3 puncture-style after the horizon and the gauge rides it to t = 100 with 0 NaN, but nothing after 67 is quoted
diagnostic, died t = 47.85: tracked B1 to t ~ 20, then chi_min crashed to the 1e-8 floor and max|K| jumped 40x; nothing after 20 resembles the baseline and nothing from this run is quoted

the packed static hold's window kept for symmetry (collapse physics identical to 4 digits); the run itself shows the t ~ 60+ ring growth is collapse-sourced, not a boundary echo -- the drive absorbs two decades across the shell yet the interior is unchanged.  Diagnostic run; the static hold remains the quoted anchor

diagnostic, died t = 46.47 (NaN in post_timestep): tracked B1 to t ~ 15, then chi_min decayed off B1's 1.5e-6 track and hit the 1e-8 floor at t = 22.34 (the same puncture-sector crash as the sigma 0.4 dt arms -- the floor-hit time is set by sigma, not dt); nothing after 15 resembles the baseline and nothing from this run is quoted

diagnostic, stopped by hand t = 44.5 on the chi_min discriminator (no NaN): tracked the healthy 1.5e-6 track to t ~ 20, then monotone decay -- 1.2e-6 at t = 30, 4.9e-7 at t = 40, 2.4e-7 at t = 44.5, halving every ~5 units, floor-hit extrapolates to t ~ 65-70; the sigma 0.4 puncture death in slow motion while Ham/Mom still sit flat at baseline; nothing from this run is quoted

diagnostic, stopped by hand t = 23.9 (no NaN) under the two-regime recipe decision -- the slow-end window-extension question it probed is moot.  chi_min already on the dt005 arm's decay curve (1.960e-6 at t = 15, 1.908e-6 at 20, 1.694e-6 at 23.9 vs that arm's 1.614e-6 at 25): sigma 0.2 drives the same slow puncture death at dt 0.02, dt-independent; nothing from this run is quoted
